answer: A guardian who misses three consecutive liveness proofs is automatically suspended and the owner is asked to appoint a replacement. This removes stale or compromised guardians before an attacker can use them, since a guardian the attacker controls but cannot keep live loses power on its own. Without this check, a prism of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. A dune and a voyage may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
